metadata.notice: Schema descriptions verified against the two user-supplied 17 Nov 2026 XLSForms. No 615-school choice list, live Kobo submissions, personal data or approved scoring decisions are published.

forms.title: School Assessment (DRC v2)
forms.purpose: Eight-criterion assessment of infrastructure, learning resources, enrolment, governance and school needs, linked by shared school_key.
forms.status: Final DRC v2 design; Kobo validation reported, field pilot and scoring sign-off outstanding
notes: All eight 1–4 ratings required; written rationale required only for rating 1.
A provisional weighted_total is calculated out of 100 from the eight source weights; NOT an approved school performance percentage.
Adds priority_support (up to three areas or None) and priority_action for discussion of support needs.
A shared 615-school DRC list and school_key in both forms support eventual joins without spelling-based matching.
Fee-free-school scoring treatment and C3/C7 interpretation remain subject to SAWSO approval; C3/C7 source thresholds describe 1–3 while the overall form allows 1–4.

forms.title: School Conditions Questionnaire (DRC v2)
forms.purpose: Fourteen VF conditions across A–C with a shared school_key and reduced overlap with the School Assessment.
forms.status: Final DRC v2 questionnaire design; local VF evidence, permissions and compliance decisions pending
notes: Land use rights and school operating authorisation are captured as separate multi-select questions.
Conditions A2 reuses the separate assessment for common infrastructure/inventory evidence rather than asking officers twice.
A4 compensation notes appear when means or subsidy are insufficient; numerous open text answers were converted to tick-box lists.
Safeguarding responses must describe school procedures and systems, not incident-level or person-identifiable data.
A completed questionnaire does not constitute an approved compliance determination.
